text:
Maria P: quick status sync on the dedicated cluster buildout — can owners call out milestones and blockers for the next 6 weeks?

Dan Liu: main blockers: two things — rack shipment dates slipped, and we still need the network ACLs from infra-net. PO 12345 shows ETA 2026-05-20 but vendor pushed to 05/27.

Alex K: noted, Dan. I've asked vendor contact (emma@edgecloud) for a hard confirmation. if racks arrive 05/27 we can still hit onboarding target but deploy window shrinks.

Infra Bot: Procurement update: PO 12345 created. Vendor: EdgeCloud. Shipment tracking: EDGE-998877 (ETA 2026-05-27).

Sophia R: networking dependency: @Sam T can you confirm ACL rule merges and cross-rack VLAN plan? we need internal L3 ready before node join.

Sam T: ACLs in PR: https://git.internal/rules/merge_requests/412 — awaiting infra-review (assigned to @Sophia R). I'll queue a hot-review if racks are confirmed. ETA for merge if reviewed today: 48h.

Maria P: ownerships: Dan — hardware logistics & node prep. Alex — cluster bringup scripts & image. Sophia — network + firewall. Sam — ACL merges + k8s network policy. I'll track rollout schedule.

Dan Liu: node prep checklist updated: https://docs.internal/dedicated/onboard-checklist.md
- BIOS updates done for 4/6 nodes
- Firmware staging image uploaded to S3: s3://infra-artifacts/dedicated/h100-202605
- RACK1 & RACK2 need PDUs connected on arrival

Alex K: bringing up a canary kube pool that mirrors prod config. reservation command (for capacity planning):
```
rbctl reserve --pool dedicated-prod --gpus 64 --start 2026-05-31 --duration 30d --owner alex.k@redwood.ai
```

Sophia R: KMS + HSM dependency for Private tenants — security needs KMS ACL before we onboard any customer VPCs. Security ticket created: SEC-678. Sam, can you coordinate with security for test keys?

Sam T: will sync with security today. If ACL PR merges we can run key provisioning in staging by 2026-06-02.

Maria P: tentative timeline if shipments hold (05/27) and ACLs merge quickly:
- 05/27–05/31: rack rack-in, PDUs, cabling
- 06/01–06/05: node join & kube bootstrap, basic e2e
- 06/06–06/10: perf/latency tests, batching profile tuning
- 06/11: internal canary traffic, start reservations for early customers

Dan Liu: risk: vendor could re-schedule again. contingency: look at local datacenter X for 8-rack short-term spin-up. I can reach out if vendor slips again.

Alex K: testing note — we need KV cache warmup scripts and a small prompt set for perf runs. I'll add to the runbook.

Infra Bot: Capacity reservation created (provisional): RES-2026-06-11-01 by Maria P — 64 GPUs.

Maria P: action items summary:
- Dan: confirm final shipment date with vendor by EOD tomorrow (owner: Dan Liu)
- Alex: prepare canary image + KV warmup scripts (owner: Alex K)
- Sophia: review & merge ACL PR, coordinate with Sam for VLAN tests (owner: Sophia R)
- Sam: coordinate KMS test keys with security and run network validation (owner: Sam T)
- I'll update the roadmap and notify sales about earliest reservation window.

Sophia R: ack, will prioritize ACL review.

Dan Liu: will follow up with vendor; posting vendor thread here when I have confirmation.

Alex K: ping me on Slack if you want me to run smoke bringup as soon as racks are cabled.

Maria P: thanks all — I'll re-open this thread with a timeline update after vendor confirms. :thumbsup:
